en.config.hint.ask: Show the confirmation step before every rerun.
en.confirm.body: The reply and everything after it leave the model context first; the turn's own prompt is sent again, and the later turns are replayed verbatim.
en.confirm.note: A rerun only changes what the model reads next; the session log is never rewritten.
en.confirm.title: Rerun this turn?
en.error.already-retired: This reply is no longer in the current context.
en.error.attachments-unsupported: The turn's prompt carries file attachments, which a rerun cannot re-admit yet.
en.error.busy: This session is still replying; wait for it to finish.
en.error.forbidden: The request origin is not allowed.
en.error.internal: The host hit an internal error; try again shortly.
en.error.invalid: Invalid request; refresh and try again.
en.error.method: The request method is not accepted; refresh and try again.
en.error.rerun-not-found: No rerun record was found for this id.
en.error.rerunning: A rerun is already in flight.
en.error.session-not-active: This session is not open in DSH; open it first.
en.error.session-not-found: No session log was found for this id.
en.error.stale: The session just changed; try again.
en.notice.deferred: Rerun interrupted: the replay of the later turns will resume automatically once the session is idle.
en.notice.loadError: Loading the state failed; try again shortly.
